mode: read-only SELECT; timestamps and join keys only

laws.L05: release released_at <= provider_dispatches.sent_at (execution_release_receipt_id)  [authority released before effect sent]
laws.L06: provider_dispatches.sent_at <= release valid_until  [release not expired at send]
laws.L13: consequence_attempts timeline monotone: prepared_at <= dispatch_started_at <= acknowledged_at <= finalized_at (where present)
laws.L14: authority_ops expected_root and expected_federation: created_at <= valid_from  [registration precedes validity]

verdict_rule: a law holds when no pair violates it; any violation is reported with its size in seconds; nothing is enforced by this campaign
privacy: no hashes, payloads, refs or ids leave the target; only per-law pair counts, violation counts and gap statistics
